USER BENCH SESSION. Decisions: threshold IS the old Preview Bridge confidence (confirmed); nudging it does nothing BY DESIGN (re-selects only when a SAM candidate score falls between old and new value - sweep, do not nudge - must go in the app info box); dilation stays 0 (user verified it grows into unwanted areas, eraser brush is the answer); BROAD 0.50 branch DROPPED, tight is enough; multiple dots segment multiple parts in one run, shirt-then-pants = two runs and that is accepted; NO slider remapping / MpiNormalizeValue rig, user retracted it, info box instead. NEW MAIN PROBLEM: mask scatter - loose specks and pinholes cost real time because the detailer masks each zone INDIVIDUALLY, so a speck buys a wasted detail pass. Same failure on the existing detect-person path, so fixing it here fixes both. Fix under test = morphological open+close, 2 nodes no new weights: GrowMaskWithBlur(expand=-4) then GrowMaskWithBlur(expand=+4, fill_holes=true), pair kept equal and opposite. Probe graph v2 rebuilt to RAW vs CLEANED, converts clean and executes live. Rejected SeparateMasks - emits a batch, needs ImpactFlattenMask, can go empty on all-scatter input.

CORRECTION + bench confirmation. WRONG EARLIER CLAIM: N dots do NOT give N objects. In the mask-points branch every point goes into ONE sam_obj.predict call, so SAM returns a SINGLE region consistent with ALL points. Bench-confirmed: one dot on the crop top = the top alone; top dot + pants dot = the WHOLE BODY; shirt + hair = the whole person. SAMDetectorSegmented has the byte-identical mask-points branch, so no escape hatch there; only the center-1 else-branch loops per-seg, but it passes each dot bbox as SAMs box constraint so a 16px dot boxes SAM into 16px unless bbox_expansion is cranked - which reintroduces the crop ceiling mask-points was chosen to avoid. PHASE A IS THEREFORE ONE PART PER RUN, as the user predicted. Multi-object-per-run parked as an unbuilt experiment (center-1 + SAMDetectorSegmented + tuned bbox_expansion). ADD/SUBTRACT IS APP-SIDE: MaskManager already keeps manualCanvas + subtractCanvas and derives maskCanvas = (manual union autoPickMasks) AND NOT subtract, so Add = draw into manualCanvas, Subtract = draw into subtractCanvas. No AddMask/SubtractMask nodes, no extra round-trip, undo preserved. SCATTER FIX CONFIRMED BY USER: the open+close pair closes the holes - RAW carried specks through hair over the shoulder, CLEANED came back solid. 4/4 is the shipping default.
